title: Mayne Pharma: Gedeon Richter Bid at $6.40 a Share
caption:
The Announcement Room | Mayne Pharma Group Limited (MYX)

Mayne Pharma entered a binding Scheme Implementation Deed with Gedeon Richter at $6.40 cash per share, a 99.4% premium to the prior close. According to the Vitti Capital Daily Mover, shares rose 78.5% in morning trade.

The deal is conditional. It needs shareholder, court, FIRB, US HSR and CFIUS clearance, and the separate $55.5 million sale of the International segment to Evaris Pharma must complete first. That sale still needs ACCC approval.

Key points:

• Binding Scheme at $6.40 cash per share
• 99.4% premium to the prior close, 124% to the 30-day VWAP
• Shares up 78.5% in morning trade (not a closing move)
• Board unanimously recommends the Scheme in the absence of a Superior Proposal
• FY26 underlying EBITDA of $34.2 million, down 27% from $47.0 million
• Implementation is targeted for March 2027

Looking ahead, the Scheme Booklet and Independent Expert's Report are due in mid-December 2026, with the Scheme Meeting set for late January 2027. These are timetable targets, not completed events, and a Superior Proposal could still emerge during exclusivity.

In this two-page investor report, we look at:

• What the Scheme terms are
• The conditions that must be met
• The FY26 earnings backdrop
• Key dates and what to watch next
